chunks.section_path: indikator-105713 > Subpilar Perikanan Tangkap dan Budidaya
chunks.content: Definisi: Indikator yang mengukur aktivitas terkait pemanfaatan sumber daya hayati laut meliputi perikanan tangkap dan budidaya (akuakultur). Interpretasi: Skor yang tinggi menunjukkan volume produksi yang besar, menandakan peran signifikan sektor ini dalam struktur perekonomian daerah. Metode Perhitungan: Subpilar ini disusun atas lima indikator: (1) Peran/kontribusi perikanan terhadap PDB; (2) Volume produksi perikanan; (3) Volume produksi budidaya tambak; (4) Volume produksi akuakultur; dan (5) Volume produksi budidaya rumput laut. Semua indikator distandarisasi, kemudian skor komposit dihitung dengan menerapkan PCA pada set indikator standar yang relevan. Bobot untuk setiap indikator ditentukan oleh loading factor komponen utama pertama. Rumus: $S_i=\sum^5_{j\mathop{=}i}(w_j\cdot I^{std}_{ij})$. Apakah Indikator Komposit: Tidak. Variabel Pembangun: Persentase Peran Sektor Perikanan dalam PDB; Volume Produksi Perikanan; Volume Produksi Budidaya Tambak; Volume Produksi Akuakultur; Volume Produksi Budidaya Rumput Laut.
chunks.content_en: Definition: an indicator measuring activity related to the use of living marine resources, covering capture fisheries and aquaculture. Interpretation: a high score indicates large production volume, signalling a significant role for the sector in the regional economic structure. Calculation: five indicators as listed; all are standardised, then the composite is computed by applying PCA to the relevant standardised indicator set, with each indicator's weight given by the first principal component loading. Constituent variables: fisheries share of GDP, fisheries production volume, pond aquaculture production volume, aquaculture production volume, seaweed aquaculture production volume.
chunks.reconstruction_note: Note the interpretation is stated in gross volume terms — a high score means high production, with no stock, sustainability or depletion adjustment. Constituent variables 2, 3, 4 overlap by construction (total production includes pond and aquaculture production).

chunks.section_path: indikator-105711 > Subpilar Perdagangan, Transportasi dan Logistik
chunks.content: Definisi: Subpilar ini mengukur tingkat konektivitas dan efisiensi logistik maritim suatu wilayah, yang merefleksikan efektivitas infrastruktur pendukung dan keberhasilan suatu wilayah dalam memanfaatkan posisi geografisnya. Interpretasi: Skor yang tinggi mencerminkan infrastruktur pelabuhan yang berfungsi baik, peran vital suatu daerah sebagai gerbang perdagangan dan daya saing produk kelautan Indonesia di kancah global. Metode Perhitungan: Subpilar ini disusun atas enam indikator. Semua indikator distandarisasi, kemudian skor komposit dihitung dengan menerapkan PCA pada set indikator standar yang relevan. Bobot untuk setiap indikator ditentukan oleh loading factor komponen utama pertama. Rumus: $S_i=\sum^6_{j\mathop{=}1}(w_j\cdot I^{std}_{ij})$. Variabel Pembangun: Volume Angkutan Laut; Jumlah Penumpang Angkutan Laut; Jumlah Penumpang Angkutan Laut di 25 Pelabuhan Strategis; Volume Ekspor Perikanan; Persentase Kontribusi Ekspor Produk Perikanan terhadap Total Ekspor; Volume Ekspor Perikanan Hidup dan Segar.
chunks.content_en: Definition: this sub-pillar measures a region's maritime connectivity and logistics efficiency, reflecting the effectiveness of supporting infrastructure and success in exploiting its geographic position. Interpretation: a high score reflects well-functioning port infrastructure, a vital role as a trade gateway, and the global competitiveness of Indonesian marine products. Calculation: six indicators, standardised, composite by PCA on the relevant standardised set, weights from the first principal component loading. Constituent variables: sea transport volume; sea transport passengers; sea transport passengers at 25 strategic ports; fisheries export volume; fisheries export share of total exports; live and fresh fisheries export volume.
chunks.reconstruction_note: Passenger counts appear twice (all ports, and the 25-strategic-ports subset), so the subset is nested inside the total within a single PCA set.

chunks.section_path: indikator-105717 > Subpilar Industri Berbasis Kelautan; indikator-105709 > Subpilar Pariwisata Berbasis Bahari
chunks.content: [105717] Definisi: Subpilar ini mengukur tingkat kemajuan dan nilai tambah dalam sektor kelautan, dari bahan mentah menuju produk olahan dan aset industri. Interpretasi: Skor yang tinggi pada sub-pilar ini mengindikasikan bahwa suatu wilayah tidak hanya menjadi pemasok bahan baku, tetapi juga pusat pengolahan dan industri maritim. Metode Perhitungan: Subpilar ini disusun atas tiga indikator. [...] Rumus: $S_i=\sum^3_{j\mathop{=}1}(w_j\cdot I^{std}_{ij})$. Variabel Pembangun: Volume Ekspor Ikan Olahan; Volume Produksi Garam; Jumlah Perahu/Kapal Penangkap Ikan. [105709] Definisi: Subpilar ini mengukur pemanfaatan sumber daya kelautan dari sisi jasa, khususnya di sektor pariwisata, yang secara langsung menghubungkan nilai ekonomi dengan kelestarian lingkungan. Interpretasi: Skor yang tinggi pada sub-pilar ini menunjukkan kemampuan suatu daerah dalam mengkapitalisasi aset alamnya secara lestari. Metode Perhitungan: Subpilar ini disusun atas dua indikator. [...] Rumus: $S_i=\sum^2_{j\mathop{=}1}(w_j\cdot I^{std}_{ij})$. Variabel Pembangun: Jumlah Wisata Bahari; Jumlah Usaha/Perusahaan Wisata Tirta Komersial.
chunks.content_en: [105717] Marine-based Industry sub-pillar: measures progress and value added in the marine sector, from raw material to processed product and industrial assets; a high score indicates a region is a processing and maritime-industry centre, not merely a raw-material supplier. Three indicators: processed fish export volume, salt production volume, number of fishing boats/vessels. [105709] Marine-based Tourism sub-pillar: measures use of marine resources on the services side, particularly tourism, directly linking economic value to environmental conservation; a high score shows a region's ability to capitalise its natural assets sustainably. Two indicators: number of marine tourism sites, number of commercial water-tourism businesses.

chunks.section_path: indikator-105715 > Subpilar Kualitas Sumber Daya dan Konservasi Laut
chunks.content: Definisi: Indikator ini mengukur kesehatan dan ketahanan sumber daya laut sebagai sistem peringatan dini dan tolak ukur keberhasilan dalam menjaga modal alam yang menjadi dasar bagi seluruh aktivitas ekonomi biru. Interpretasi: Semakin tinggi nilainya, menunjukkan bahwa sumber daya dan lingkungan laut berada dalam kondisi baik. Metode Perhitungan: Subpilar ini disusun atas sembilan indikator. Semua indikator distandarisasi, kemudian skor komposit dihitung dengan menerapkan PCA pada set indikator standar yang relevan. Bobot untuk setiap indikator ditentukan oleh loading factor komponen utama pertama. Rumus: $S_i=\sum^9_{j\mathop{=}1}(w_k\cdot I^{std}_{ij})$. Variabel Pembangun: Persentase Kawasan Terumbu Karang Berkualitas Baik; Persentase Kawasan Kamun Berkualitas Baik; Persentase Kawasan Hutan Mangrove Berkualitas Baik; Jumlah Desa Pesisir dengan Tempat Pembuangan Sampah; Jumlah Desa Pesisir dengan Tempat Buang Air Besar; Luas Kawasan Penanaman/Rehabilitasi Hutan Mangrove, Rawa, dan Lahan Gambut; Volume Kebocoran Sampah Laut; Jumlah Sampah yang DIbuang di Darat; Luas Kawasan Konservasi Perairan.
chunks.content_en: Definition: this indicator measures the health and resilience of marine resources as an early-warning system and benchmark of success in maintaining the natural capital underpinning all blue economy activity. Interpretation: higher values indicate marine resources and environment in good condition. Calculation: nine indicators, standardised, composite by PCA, weights from the first principal component loading. Constituent variables: percentage of good-quality coral reef area; percentage of good-quality seagrass area ('Kamun' is a typo for 'Lamun'); percentage of good-quality mangrove forest area; coastal villages with waste disposal points; coastal villages with defecation facilities; area of mangrove, swamp and peatland planting/rehabilitation; marine litter leakage volume; land-disposed waste; aquatic conservation area extent.
chunks.reconstruction_note: This is the sub-pillar closest in intent to ecosystem accounting — it invokes 'modal alam' (natural capital) explicitly. Two published typographical errors quoted as-is: 'Kamun' for 'Lamun' (seagrass) in the variable name, and the summation index in the formula mixes w_k with j. No SEEA-EA extent, condition or ecosystem-services account is named as a source; the constituent variables are condition percentages, village facility counts, waste volumes and protected-area extent.

chunks.content_en: [105710] Welfare sub-pillar: measures how the marine sector supports community welfare; three indicators — share of fisheries workers receiving PKH, number of women workers in fisheries, number of fishers and fish farmers. chunks.content_en: Definition: this sub-pillar measures the availability of infrastructure and the success of education in producing quality human resources in the maritime field. Interpretation: a higher score indicates better infrastructure availability and human-resource quality in the maritime field. chunks.section_path: Konflik internal: Tabel 1 (empat pilar) vs Tabel 4/5 dan Gambar 11 (tiga pilar)
chunks.content: [Locus A — Tabel 1, Indikator Indeks Ekonomi Biru Indonesia, hlm. 11-13 (pdf 21-23):] "Pilar: Enabler (teknologi & tata kelola) — Subpilar: Pariwisata berbasis bahari (indikator 15-16); Subpilar “-” (indikator 17-18)." [Locus B — Tabel 4, Bobot IBEI 2025 berdasarkan pilar, hlm. 94 (pdf 104):] "Kode Pillar / Nama Pilar / Kontribusi terhadap IBEI: si_enviro | Index pilar lingkungan | Tinggi (36,9%); si_econ | Index pilar ekonomi | Sedang (32,6%); si_social | Index pilar sosial | Rendah (30,5%)." [Locus B — Tabel 5, Bobot subpilar dalam membentuk pilar IBEI, hlm. 94 (pdf 104):] "Pembentuk Pilar Ekonomi: ... si_econ_s4 | Indeks subpilar pariwisata berbasis kelautan | Tinggi (22,1%); si_econ_tech | Indeks subpilar teknologi | Rendah (4,1%); si_econ_gov | Indeks subpilar tatakelola | Sedang (15,8%)."
chunks.content_en: Recorded conflict, not resolved. Locus A (Tabel 1, pp. 11-13 [pdf 21-23]) prints a FOUR-pillar structure in which a pillar 'Enabler (teknologi & tata kelola)' holds indicators 15-18, with marine tourism as its sub-pillar (15-16) and an unnamed sub-pillar printed as a dash (17-18). Locus B (Tabel 4 and Tabel 5, p. 94 [pdf 104], consistent with Gambar 11) prints a THREE-pillar structure — si_enviro 36.9%, si_econ 32.6%, si_social 30.5% — with no Enabler pillar, and places marine tourism (22.1%), technology (4.1%) and governance (15.8%) as sub-pillars OF the Economy pillar. The two loci are incompatible on both the number of pillars and the parent of indicators 15-18. Neither is adopted here. The indicator_join_table propagates the Tabel 1 (four-pillar) labels for rows 15-18; those rows carry pillar_placement_conflict recording the alternative Ekonomi placement. Any re-scoring that aggregates by pillar must state which locus it follows.
chunks.maturity_note: Specification chunk: states what the IBEI requires or how it is weighted, not that any datum is produced and published. maturity_tag is not_applicable because the maturity scale applies to data availability; the Juknis itself is a published document, which is a separate matter from the availability of the inputs it names.
